name: ZCA_INTG_INSTANCE
description: This table is used to store the integration instance.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: This column is the primary key of the table holding unique value.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_NAME
columns.description: This column holds IntegrationName which is derived from Routine Name.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column holds the description of the integration instance created.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_INSTANCE_NUMBER
columns.description: This is the PUID column of the table holding unique value.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_MAP_ID
columns.description: This column is a Foreign Key to ZCA_INTEGRATION_MAPS.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_MAPPING_NUMBER
columns.description: This column holds the INTEGRATION_MAPPING_NUMBER from ZCA_INTEGRATION_MAPS.

columns.name: ROUTINE_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: This column holds the value of RoutineExecution.

columns.name: ROUTINE_ID
columns.description: This column holds the value of RoutineDefinition which is a foreign key to ZCA_WBOTS.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates the State of an Integration.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column indicates the Status of an Integration.

columns.name: SIGNAL_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the signal event that was raised for the integration instance.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_PAYLOAD
columns.description: This column holds integration payload generated by routines.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_START_TIME
columns.description: The start time of the integration instance.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_END_TIME
columns.description: The end time of the integration instance.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the parent request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_RULE
columns.description: The condition used for defining the integration.

columns.name: PROPERTY_FLAGS
columns.description: This column holds the bit mask indicator to differentiate properties like LockedFlag,BatchFlag.If the column has a value of 3 then it can be treated as bit 11.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: The schedule details of a batch integration.
